 8th Pay Commission implementation likely from Jan 1
 By
 Whispers In The Corridors News desk 
 October 29, 2026 · 9:42 AM 
 1 min read 
 The 8th Pay Commission is likely to be implemented from 1 January 2026. After the announcement by the central government, all state governments will also form committees for the Pay Commission.
